procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Zoran Grubisa (chairman of the technical committee)
GBR 188N -Django JP- was represented by Michele Ivaldi (tactician).
facts: GBR 188N -Django JP- was selected for a post-race equipment inspection on the water after race #2 (1st inshore race).

At the time of the inspection GBR 188N -Django JP- carried an asymmetric spinnaker on board that did not have an event sticker and that was not included in the list of spinnakers registered for the event.
GBR 188N -Django JP- did not use the spinnaker during the race.
GBR 188N -Django JP- stated that the sail was taken on board by one of the team members by mistake as there was a crew change between the offshore race and the inshore races.
conclusions: GBR 188N -Django JP- failed to comply with NoR 1(e)(ii) by having a spinnaker on board that did not have an event sticker.
decision: Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines for Boats & Support Persons a starting penalty of 20% (Band 2) was decided.

The penalty was decreased because GBR 188N -Django JP- did not have a performance advantage as the sail was not used, the breach was an error in checking the sails to be carried on board and the party regrets the breach.
There were no circumstances to justify increasing the penalty.
The penalty is a 10% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in rule 44.3(c) and applied to race #2.
